env BOLERO_MODULE=off
[short] skip # rebuilds std for alternate architecture

cd mycmd
bolero build mycmd

# cross-compile install with implicit BOLERO_BIN=$BOLERO_PATH/bin can make subdirectory
env GOARCH=386
[GOARCH:386] env GOARCH=amd64
env GOOS=linux
bolero install mycmd
exists $BOLERO_PATH/bin/linux_$GOARCH/mycmd

# cross-compile install with explicit BOLERO_BIN cannot make subdirectory
env BOLERO_BIN=$WORK/bin
! bolero install mycmd
! exists $BOLERO_BIN/linux_$GOARCH

# The install directory for a cross-compiled standard command should include GOARCH.
bolero list -f '{{.Target}}'  cmd/pack
stdout ${BOLERO_ROOT}[/\\]pkg[/\\]tool[/\\]${GOOS}_${GOARCH}[/\\]pack$

-- mycmd/x.go --
package main
func main() {}
